bloxfruits.name: Blox Fruits
howTo: Tap the Settings button (gear icon) on the left side of the screen.
On the Settings menu, look for the Redeem DLC Code section and click Redeem .
Copy and paste a working code from our list into the box and press Redeem .

animevanguards.name: Anime Vanguards
howTo: Tap the Profile button on the right side of the screen.
Tap the Codes button to the left of the profile screen.
Copy and paste a code from our list into the codes box and press Redeem.

kinglegacy.name: King Legacy
howTo: Open King Legacy on Roblox.
Find and tap the Menu button on the top left corner of the game.
Tap the Shop button ($ icon).
Find the Codes section at the bottom of the Shop menu.
Paste a working code into the box.
Press Redeem to claim the reward.

adoptme.name: Adopt Me!
howTo: Open Adopt Me on Roblox.
Go to the Safety Hub .
Interact with the Code Redemption Kiosk .
Paste a working code into the box.

animeadventures.name: Anime Adventures
howTo: To use codes in Anime Adventures, first head to the CODES section, found in the middle of the main spawn area
Next, type your code into the Enter Code box, and then click Redeem

bladeball.name: Blade Ball
howTo: to redeem codes in Blade Ball, first press the EXTRA button on the top left corner of the screen
Then, press the CODES button
Lastly, enter your code in the Type code here! box and press the Confirm icon

fisch.name: Fisch
howTo: Open Roblox Fisch on your device.
Press M to open the in-game Menu.
Scroll down to the Codes section.
Input a working Code in the codes box.
Press Enter to claim the reward associated with the code.

volleyballlegends.name: Volleyball Legends
howTo: Open Volleyball Legends on Roblox.
Tap the Shop button on the bottom of the screen.
Navigate to the Codes section int he Shop.
Enter a Working Code in the codes box.
Press Use Code to redeem the reward.

growagarden.name: Grow a Garden
howTo: To claim codes in Grow a Garden, first click on the cog in the top left hand corner of the game to open the settings menu
Then, scroll to the bottom of the settings menu, enter a code into the Type code here... box and click Claim to claim it

nights99.name: 99 Nights in the Forest

Tap the Codes button inside the shop.
Paste a working code into the box and tap Submit .
Enjoy your free rewards!

Paste a working code into the box.
Press Redeem to claim the reward.

typesoul.name: Type Soul
howTo: Open Type Soul on Roblox.
Tap the Gift Box icon at the top of the screen.
Enter a working Code into the box.
Press Redeem to claim the reward.

Enter a working Code in the box and tap Redeem .

Navigate to the Rewards tab.
Paste a working code into the box.
Press Redeem to claim the reward.

Press the Menu button to expand the menu.
Press the Codes button to open the codes page.
Paste a working code into the box.
Press Redeem to claim the reward.

hypershot.name: Hypershot

Paste a code into the codes box at the bottom of the Rewards menu.

rivals.name: RIVALS
howTo: To redeem codes in RIVALS, first click on the + button at the top of the screen
Next, at the top right corner of the menu, click on the More button
Next, click on the Codes button
You must follow the developers Nosniy Games, SenseiWarrior and Nosniy to redeem codes.
Next, scroll down to the bottom of the codes menu. Type your code into the Enter a special code here box, and then click Redeem

steal-a-brainrot.name: Steal a Brainrot

fish-it.name: Fish It!

After that, scroll to the bottom of the page, enter the code into the ENTER CODE! box and click REDEEM

chameleon.name: Chameleon
howTo: First, click the CODES icon on the left side

tower-of-hell.name: Tower of Hell
